# Arun Karthik BT — AI Engineer

## Summary
Arun Karthik BT is an AI Software Engineer at 10xScale.ai in Hyderabad, India. He builds production LLM systems: multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, AgentFlow, MCP/FastMCP), RAG and hybrid retrieval, real-time voice agents (LiveKit), and structured extraction with Gemini and Vertex AI, served by FastAPI, PostgreSQL and task queues.

## Experience
- AI Software Engineer, 10xScale.ai (Jul 2026 – Present): Nirnaya legal-intelligence platform; AI tutoring and career-readiness platform.
- AI Intern, 10xScale.ai (Jul 2025 – Dec 2025): medical chatbot, database agent, pgvector RAG chatbot.
- AI Intern, FourKites (Apr 2024 – Jun 2024): CrewAI multi-agent data conversion.
